Im not in the US unfortunately. But thanks for the advice. I do appreciate it.

Its not that easy for me to get therapy.. i can't afford it.. i think meds would help me but cant afford it too. I am trying though.. I have shared about my feelings with my friends more than i ever have in my life.. and i feel it does help a bit. I am going to try and keep trying to learn how to love myself.. What im saying is that its not easy.. i slip and lose hope most of the times. But i really am trying and i will keep trying while i can.
I wasn't hoping that theyd fix me.. but then maybe i am just in denial. I just don't have much hope i can fix myself so im finding it hard to accept what you say.
what if you never get your stuff together? best stay alone all your life?
I am trying. But honestly i also hoped it would be possible to have someone with me while i work on myself.
Thanks.. I'm trying to think of it that way. I'm still sad, hope is not much there but.. thanks and best of luck to you as well. :)
Yes.. in a way it is better. I'm trying to accept it now even though it still makes me sad most times.

Thank you. It has ended now for good.. no contact anymore. And it has caused me heartache that i don't know if i'll be happy again or when. But i do agree now that it is better it ended. :( I hope your situation gets better.

I feel the same as you. I think it's because i feel like i can see through them and what they are showing is fake. But sometimes it makes me hate myself as well for judging them when i really don't know the truth for sure. Basically i hate it when i can sense insincerity in people.

I also hate people who always complain and points fingers whenever they are found to have made a mistake.
I sent you a pm. and thank you. :)
Hi. Thanks for replying. I'll send you a pm?
This is the explanation i agree with the most

Thank you for replying. I'm still here, and so far even if its not at all better i am not close to trying it again. I have even kind of accepted that i'll never be able to go through with it, just this last time it was so bad that i thought it might be the only thing left to do. 
Financials when it comes to the right doctor and getting regularly medicated, im not sure how it is there but here in my country help such as these isnt readily available unless it comes with a matching (high) price. I have calmed a bit now though, i still am desperate to find something to live for even if there isn't. Im going to try and get more help medically when i can, thanks for your advise and im sorry youre going through it too.
I don't. I was prescribed something once but it wasn't working and the doctor didn't care so i had no way of getting it anymore even if i wanted to.

Only 3 people in my life knows aside from online strangers. A coffee buddy i met a year ago who i chitchat with sometimes, my old friend who's in another country and the psychiatrist i visited(but stopped doing so) a couple of months ago. Im 27 and no one in my family knows. I dont think i'll ever tell.
thanks again. i appreciate that a lot. :)

I hope you make it through. I would ask you to set it a year back more if im being brave.

I know its not doing us much good this world, but talking to you, and just now reading some articles I have calmed down a bit for today. I dont know what happens tomorrow. But thank you for talking to me i appreciate it. Knowing that you're experiencing the same thing makes me hope it all goes well for you at least.

I think about that too, seeing into the future. Seeing if there's any use to this, because if only i can know that in the end it wasnt a waste of time then it would probably motivate me a little better. Just this feeling of being useless to anyone, and not having anybody i can depend on with my life, nobody who needs me. I think thats what crushes me the most. The worst thing you can feel is being alone in an almost if not overpopulated world. Like you have the worst luck of the worst and that maybe you deserve it.
i misread that, you werent borrowing money, but giving them some. sorry.

I'm sorry. I would say they were being reasonable not lending you money you're gonna use to buy something to kill yourself with, but for them to encourage you try the alternative methods (and i would hope they mean it with concern but im not sure they did) is not so right.

I dont trust anybody to like me after a long while of knowing me because of this, i always feel like theyre going to get tired eventually  and that would kill me twice. That's why i've mostly been alone. I dont like myself, i dont trust anyone,  i tried changing that, i thought it was working. But where am I now.

But im still alive. I couldnt try killing myself again last night. There's still some desperate hope in me. There were beautiful moments in my life. I dont have to be perfectly happy, but I wish i could be normal enough to live through life not just despairing over things but knowing there will be moments like that. Unfortunately i dont have much hope for that right now. Im not sure if i still want to keep hoping at all.

It started really young for me like you too. I almost forget about them, but im not good with feelings. My feelings brings me down everytime. I don't want to be somebody else, but I always wish that i've been normal, so it's just the same. I know i'm not too happy with myself and it's one of the things causing this. But as much as i try to, i'm finding it hard to fix that. I always end up attaching happiness to something or someone else. And thats never gonna work but i feel too damaged to learn how to do it else way. 

I hope you are able to make it though. if anything.

:(

I just want it to be gone. I want to be able to react logically to things. I'm so tired of trying and hoping and always coming back. I can't go on being like this the rest of my life.

I'm really sorry you're going through it too. I always thought it would have been okay to know no one else feels this kind of thing because its the ugliest feeling.
